title: Beacon Tower
summary: A reinforced observation tower extends above the parapet, housing a failing beacon array and a locked maintenance hatch. The desert wind howls through a cracked ventilation grille.
arrival_narration: You step onto a narrow metal platform jutting from the parapet’s edge. The beacon tower looms ahead—a skeletal lattice of rusted steel, its top half shrouded in flickering amber light. A maintenance hatch, half-buried in debris, sits at the base. A ventilation grille groans in the wind, scattering loose papers. The horizon shifts slightly—something glints in the dusk’s last light.

spatial_anomalies: flickering amber light from beacon array
